body:
Hi,
I get this as well. I thought when chrome was launched via Cypress this was supposed to be suppressed. Did you find a workaround?
Regards,
Andy
@larscom @ap1969  no, but please place a :+1: on the top level to help us gauge the importance of this
I have this prompt when changing the active test in cypress UI (which closes the previous test window and opens a new one).

There used to be a command-line flag for this (`--disable-session-crashed-bubble`) but it got removed in Chrome 58. We can load the Preferences and use this method to fix it before we launch: https://superuser.com/a/886258/458816
